_doc: zoominview styles. plan.py picks one hook (the person's reaction), one reveal (the camera move from the face to the view) and one music style that fit --setting/--light/--country, skipping the last 3 of each used, plus a caption hook line. reveal.a = clip A: the reaction ({hook}) then the transition, ending STILL on the view or on a still transition frame; reveal.b = clip B, rendered from A's last frame (CONTINUE_FROM), ends with {zoom} (the shared gentle zoom-in-and-hold). {place}, {view}, {focus}, {person}, {hook}, {zoom} are filled by plan.py. reveal_at = seconds into clip B when the view is fully open (negative: inside clip A) (the music drop lands there). music.style feeds ../muse-video/scripts/music.py --style; file = a ready track with its own .beats.json (drop = when it swells). captions: hook lines by setting, {name} = the place's first name part.

reveals.name: Gasp at the view off to the side, one pan the way the eyes look onto the view, then one long zoom in (the reference reel)
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera held at arm's length, slightly below the face. {person} stands near the edge of a high viewpoint at {place}, looking past the camera and off to the RIGHT side of the frame at something enormous there. Behind the person there is only sky with clouds and the top of a grassy hillside: no sea, no cliffs, the view is NOT behind them. {hook} The head stays up and the eyes stay fixed on the view to the right, amazed: never bowing the head, never closing the eyes, never covering the face. In the last 2.5 seconds the phone pans to the RIGHT, exactly the way the eyes are looking, in one continuous fluid handheld move with motion blur: the face slides out of the left edge of the frame, the camera sweeps across the grass and scrub on the hillside, follows the rough edge of the cliff, and the view the person was staring at opens up beyond the edge: {view}. The pan ends with the phone pointing exactly along the person's line of sight, the view seen as they see it from where they stand: wide and far away, {focus} small in the distance in the centre of the frame, with plenty of sea, coastline and sky all around it. The pan eases out and STOPS: for the last 0.7 seconds the phone is held completely still and level on that wide view.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video from exactly the first frame, a wide view from far away. The camera stays aimed at {focus}, in the centre of the frame: it never turns, pans, tilts or moves sideways, never looks away, never reframes. From the very first frame {zoom} The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame: the sun does not set further, no darkening. Nobody in frame.

reveals.name: Pan the way the eyes look, lands on a leading line (river, road, boardwalk, shoreline) running to the focus, zoom in (reference reel 2)
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera held at arm's length. {person} stands in a wide open place at {place}, low down, looking past the camera and off to the RIGHT side of the frame. Behind the person only a green hillside with trees or a meadow and a bit of sky: the view is NOT behind them. {hook} The head stays up and the eyes stay on the view to the right. In the last 2.2 seconds the phone pans to the RIGHT, the way the eyes look, in one fast fluid handheld sweep with motion blur across trees and open ground, and lands on a strong leading line at the person's feet, a river, road, boardwalk, path or shoreline, running from the bottom of the frame into the distance straight toward {focus}: {view}. The pan eases out and STOPS: for the last 0.7 seconds the phone is held completely still and level, the line leading the eye to {focus} small and far away.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video from exactly the first frame. The camera stays aimed down the leading line at {focus}, in the centre of the frame. From the very first frame {zoom} The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame. Nobody in frame.

reveals.name: Pan the way the eyes look onto a river/valley line, one steady forward glide along it that eases to a stop on a wide view, then a slow push-in toward the focus with the water flowing (reference reel 2, long form ~16 s)
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera held at arm's length. {person} stands in an open green meadow at {place}, looking past the camera and off to the LEFT side of the frame at something enormous there. Behind the person only a forest slope, a meadow and a bit of sky: the view is NOT behind them. {hook} The head stays up and the eyes stay on the view to the left. From second 3 the phone pans to the LEFT, the way the eyes look, in one fast fluid handheld sweep with light motion blur past a tree and the meadow, then tilts down slightly and lands on {line} at the person's feet, running from the bottom of the frame straight into the distance toward {focus}: {view}. The pan eases out and STOPS: for the last 0.7 seconds the phone is held completely still and level, {focus} small and far away above the end of the line.
reveals.b: Continue the same video from exactly the first frame. The camera now moves FORWARD along {line}, low above the ground like a slow steady gimbal or drone glide, always aimed at {focus} in the centre of the frame. ONE CONSTANT, CALM SPEED for the whole glide, like walking pace seen from a few metres up: no speed-up, no slow-down mid-way, no rush. It travels in a straight line and only forward: it never turns away, never reverses, never orbits, never rolls or tilts the horizon, never climbs or dives suddenly. Fields, trees and banks pass by at the sides at a believable speed for that pace; {focus} grows slowly and stays rigid, the same shape and size relation to the mountains around it. At second 6 the glide eases out and STOPS on a wide, balanced view: {focus} in the upper centre, clearly closer than at the start but still far away with the land around it, {line} and the green land in the lower third. From second 7 to the end it is a LOCKED-OFF TRIPOD SHOT: the frame does not move at all, no sideways drift, no truck, no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no rise. Only the water in {line}, the grass and the clouds move. The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame.
reveals.c: Continue the same video from exactly the first frame. The camera keeps going FORWARD along {line} in a very slow, steady push-in toward {focus} in the upper centre, at one constant gentle speed, slower than walking pace: no speed-up, no turn, no sideways drift, no tilt, no climb, no zoom back out. The water flows and sparkles at real speed, the grass sways a little, the clouds drift slowly. {focus} grows only slightly and stays rigid; the cliffs, trees and buildings keep their shapes. For the last second the camera is still while the water keeps flowing. The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame.

reveals.name: Looks UP at something towering, the phone tilts up the way the eyes look (waterfalls, peaks, temples, towers)
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera held at arm's length, at chest height. {person} stands at the foot of something enormous at {place}, looking UP past the top of the camera. Behind the person only a little sky and greenery: the giant thing is NOT behind them. {hook} The head tilts back and the eyes stay up on it. In the last 2.2 seconds the phone tilts UP, the way the eyes look, in one fluid handheld move: the face slides out of the bottom of the frame and {focus} rises into view, towering above: {view}. The tilt eases out and STOPS: for the last 0.7 seconds the phone is held completely still on the whole of {focus}, top to bottom in the frame with sky around it.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video from exactly the first frame, looking up at {focus}. From the very first frame {zoom} The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame. Nobody in frame.

reveals.name: Reaction, then a fast whip pan sideways that snaps to a stop on the view
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera at arm's length. {person} at {place} stares past the camera and off to the RIGHT side of the frame. Behind the person only sky and a hilltop or trees: the view is NOT behind them. {hook} The head stays up and the eyes stay on the view to the right. In the last 1.8 seconds the phone whips to the RIGHT, the way the eyes look, in one fast horizontal pan with strong motion blur, then decelerates smoothly and settles level on the view: {view}. The pan eases out and STOPS: for the last 0.7 seconds the phone is held completely still and level on that view, {focus} small and far away in the centre, the view seen exactly as the person sees it from where they stand.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video from exactly the first frame, a wide view from far away. The camera stays aimed at {focus}, in the centre of the frame. From the very first frame {zoom} The view: {view}. The light stays exactly as in the first frame. Nobody in frame.

reveals.name: Hand covers the lens, slides away to the view
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera at arm's length. {person} at {place} looks past the camera at something behind it. {hook} The head stays up, the face stays uncovered. Then one hand comes up toward the lens and covers it completely; the clip ends on the warm, softly lit palm filling the whole frame, held still.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video. It starts on a palm filling the frame; the hand slides away to the side, the exposure adjusts naturally, and behind it the wide view is revealed, far away: {view}. The camera holds still and level for a moment, then {zoom} Nobody in frame after the hand leaves.

reveals.name: Gasp, turns to the view, camera rises over the shoulder and glides in
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone video filmed by a friend facing {person} at {place}. The person looks past the camera at the view. {hook} Then the person slowly turns around toward the view behind them. The camera follows close behind the shoulder and hair; the clip ends still on the back of the head and shoulder filling most of the frame, bright sky glowing around it.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video. It starts close behind the person's shoulder and hair; the camera rises gently over the shoulder and glides forward past them, the person slides out of the frame at the bottom, and the wide view opens out, far away: {view}. The glide eases out and stops level, then {zoom}

reveals.name: Reaches the top, points ahead, camera rises over the crest
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera at arm's length. {person} takes the last steps up a trail at {place}, glances over the top and freezes. {hook} Then the person points ahead past the camera. The phone tips down and the clip ends still on the trail and the edge of the crest right in front of the boots, sky above it. The view is NOT shown yet.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video. It starts on the trail and the crest edge; the camera moves forward and rises slowly over the crest, and the wide view opens out beyond it, far away: {view}. The rise eases out and stops level, then {zoom} Nobody in frame.

reveals.name: Opens the shutters/curtains, bright light, steps out to the view
reveals.a: Vertical smartphone selfie video, front camera, inside a simple hotel room at {place}. {person}, just woken up, pulls the curtains open; light floods the face and the person looks out past the camera. {hook} Then the phone turns toward the bright open window and the clip ends still on the softly overexposed glowing window frame.
reveals.b: Continue the same handheld smartphone video. It starts on a softly overexposed bright window; the exposure settles naturally as the camera moves through the window onto the balcony, and the wide view opens out: {view}. The camera stops level at the railing, then {zoom} Nobody in frame.

zoom: the lens ZOOMS IN slowly and smoothly toward {focus}, a gentle zoom of only about 1.5x in total, like a careful hand on a phone camera. After about 5 seconds the zoom eases out and STOPS, with {focus} filling only about a third of the frame and the landscape still all around it: a balanced composition, never a close-up. For the rest of the clip the phone is held still on that framing: it never zooms further in, never zooms back out, never pans away; the last frame is framed exactly like the frame at 5 seconds.

hooks.name: Silent gasp, hand pressed to the forehead (reference reel 1)
hooks.text: Real, overwhelmed surprise: eyes wide, mouth falling open in a silent gasp, one hand pressed to the forehead, wind blowing the hair.

hooks.name: Calm, speechless awe, hand resting on top of the head (reference reel 2)
hooks.text: Calm, speechless awe, no gasp: the lips stay closed or barely parted, a slow deep breath out, one hand slides up through the hair and rests on top of the head, the eyes soft, wide and still, as if the view is too beautiful to be real.

hooks.name: Short silent laugh of disbelief, slow head shake
hooks.text: Disbelief: a short silent laugh breaks out, the head shakes slowly while the eyes never leave the view, one hand rubs the back of the neck.

hooks.name: Lowers the sunglasses slowly to see it properly
hooks.text: Wearing sunglasses at first, the person slowly lowers them down the nose with one finger to see it properly; the eyebrows rise, the lips part in a silent 'wow', the eyes widen.

hooks.name: Out of breath from the climb, stops dead
hooks.text: Out of breath from the climb, cheeks flushed, chest rising and falling; the person stops dead, both hands on the hips, and stares, mouth slightly open.

hooks.name: A gust hits, silent laugh, pushes the hair back, eyes back on the view
hooks.text: A strong gust of wind blows the hair across the face for a moment; the person laughs silently and pushes it back with one hand, and the eyes go straight back to the view, wide and amazed.

hooks.name: Goosebumps: rubs the forearm, slow exhale, glistening eyes
hooks.text: Moved: a slow exhale through the lips, one hand rubs the goosebumps on the other forearm, the eyes glisten in the light, a small amazed smile.

hooks.name: Wrapped in a jacket at dawn, breath visible, first light on the face
hooks.text: Wrapped in a warm jacket in the cold early morning, breath visible in the air; first sunlight reaches the face, the eyes widen, a slow silent 'oh'.
